game.name: Winter Stars (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Winter Stars is a winter sports game on Xbox 360 that can be played with Kinect. No less than eleven disciplines await you, including skiing, snowboarding, bobsleigh, biathlon and curling. A career mode puts you in the shoes of a young team manager and a multiplayer mode playable by up to four players, online or offline, completes the picture.
